generated.threadsAnswer:
Answer: Hyperparathyroidism

👀 What you see:
Smooth round holes sit punched through several finger and hand bones while the bone around them looks thinned and washed out.

🦴 Why it matters:
An overactive parathyroid gland is pulling calcium out of the skeleton and dumping it into the kidneys.

💊 Treatment:
Removing the overactive gland stops the bone loss and the skeleton slowly rebuilds.
